summary: Discover how AI and Machine Learning can revolutionize Geospatial Analysis. Enroll in our training courses to gain practical skills and industry knowledge.
lede: AI and machine learning for geospatial analysis teaches you to transform satellite imagery, sensor feeds, and mapping layers into useful intelligence. You will build practical models that classify images, identify hotspots, detect objects, and uncover patterns over time. Starting with Python, geospatial libraries, and machine learning fundamentals, the course quickly moves into applied workflows. You will train, test, evaluate, and deploy models while developing the coding, spatial reasoning, and model assessment skills needed to bring AI into geospatial work.
audience: GIS analysts ready to scale maps
modules: Deep Learning: CNNs for Remote Sensing
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
